section: India - national parks, wildlife sanctuaries, biosphere reserves, conservation reserves
subsections: PA categories under WPA 1972 - NP vs WLS vs conservation and community reserves

accepted.s:
With reference to protected areas under the Wildlife Protection Act, 1972, consider the following statements:
1. A National Park provides the highest degree of protection among the categories listed.
2. Grazing and private rights are not permitted in a National Park.
3. Some activities and rights may be regulated but allowed in a Wildlife Sanctuary.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: National Parks provide the highest protection, with no grazing or private rights. Wildlife Sanctuaries permit some regulated activities and rights; hence all three statements are correct.
accepted.tq: Combine closely related provisions and identify the option containing all correct statements.
accepted.sec: PA categories under WPA 1972 - NP vs WLS vs conservation and community reserves

accepted.s: A Conservation Reserve under Section 36A of the Wildlife Protection Act, 1972, is generally established on:
o: Land located exclusively inside a National Park
Government-owned land adjoining or linking protected areas
Any urban land notified by a municipal body
Private land volunteered by a community
accepted.x: A Conservation Reserve is declared by the State on government-owned land next to or linking protected areas, after consultation with local people.
accepted.tq: Test the location and ownership condition attached to a statutory category.
accepted.sec: PA categories under WPA 1972 - NP vs WLS vs conservation and community reserves

accepted.s: Which one of the following is correctly matched regarding Conservation Reserves?
o: Declared by the State; local rights remain unaffected; managed through committees involving panchayats
Declared by local communities; all customary rights are extinguished
Declared only by the Union Government; grazing is automatically prohibited
Declared by the State on private land; the land must be outside all protected areas
accepted.x: Conservation Reserves are declared by the State on government land, local rights remain unaffected, and management committees include panchayats. Private or community land is relevant to Community Reserves.
accepted.tq: Use ownership, authority and rights as separate elimination clues.
accepted.sec: PA categories under WPA 1972 - NP vs WLS vs conservation and community reserves

accepted.s: A Community Reserve differs from a Conservation Reserve in that a Community Reserve is declared on:
o: Land acquired compulsorily by the Union Government
Private or community land voluntarily offered by the community
Wetlands situated within a National Park
Government land adjoining a National Park
accepted.x: A Community Reserve is established by the State on private or community land voluntarily offered by the community. Its rights remain unaffected, and the land cannot already be inside a National Park, Wildlife Sanctuary or Conservation Reserve.
accepted.tq: Discriminate between the two reserve categories by comparing land ownership.
accepted.sec: PA categories under WPA 1972 - NP vs WLS vs conservation and community reserves

accepted.s: Which of the following conditions regarding a Community Reserve is correct?
o: It can be declared only on land owned by the State Government
It may be declared inside an existing National Park without restriction
The land must not be situated inside a National Park, Wildlife Sanctuary or Conservation Reserve
The community loses all rights after declaration
accepted.x: Community Reserve land is private or community land voluntarily offered for conservation, and it must not be inside a National Park, Wildlife Sanctuary or Conservation Reserve. Rights remain unaffected.
accepted.tq: Find the precise statutory restriction among options that reverse ownership or rights.
accepted.sec: PA categories under WPA 1972 - NP vs WLS vs conservation and community reserves

accepted.s: Mining is prohibited inside National Parks and Wildlife Sanctuaries and, ordinarily, within what distance from their boundary?
accepted.x: Mining is banned inside National Parks and Wildlife Sanctuaries and within 1 kilometre of their boundary, unless a larger Eco-Sensitive Zone has been notified.
accepted.tq: Test the statutory distance figure with closely spaced numerical options.
accepted.sec: PA categories under WPA 1972 - NP vs WLS vs conservation and community reserves

accepted.s: Which recent judicially noted measure applies to wetland Conservation Reserves?
o: A 1-kilometre prohibition on all tourism activities
A complete ban on local rights
accepted.x: The Supreme Court extended a 10-kilometre mining buffer to all wetland Conservation Reserves. This is distinct from the ordinary 1-kilometre buffer around National Parks and Wildlife Sanctuaries.
accepted.tq: Separate the exceptional buffer from the ordinary protected-area rule.
accepted.sec: PA categories under WPA 1972 - NP vs WLS vs conservation and community reserves

accepted.s: Tsarap Chu, noted as India's largest high-altitude protected area, is located in:
accepted.x: Tsarap Chu is in Spiti, Himachal Pradesh. It is described as India's largest high-altitude protected area and Himachal Pradesh's fifth Conservation Reserve.
accepted.tq: Link the protected area with its state and distinctive superlative.
accepted.sec: PA categories under WPA 1972 - NP vs WLS vs conservation and community reserves

accepted.s: Tsarap Chu is significant in Himachal Pradesh because it is the State's:
accepted.x: Tsarap Chu in Spiti is identified as Himachal Pradesh's fifth Conservation Reserve.
accepted.tq: Use the ordinal figure as the decisive fact rather than the location alone.
accepted.sec: PA categories under WPA 1972 - NP vs WLS vs conservation and community reserves

accepted.s: Which one of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: Musk deer — Kedarnath and Askot Wildlife Sanctuaries
accepted.x: Musk deer habitat includes Kedarnath Wildlife Sanctuary and Askot Wildlife Sanctuary in Uttarakhand. Hangul is associated with Dachigam, Barasingha with Kanha, and snow leopard with Cold Desert Biosphere Reserve and Kibber.
accepted.tq: Start with the sure species-habitat pair and eliminate the swapped associations.

accepted.s: The Great Indian Bustard is associated with which of the following protected-area pairs?
o: Desert National Park and Rollapadu Wildlife Sanctuary
Kanha National Park and Dachigam National Park
Cold Desert Biosphere Reserve and Kibber
Kedarnath Wildlife Sanctuary and Askot Wildlife Sanctuary
accepted.x: The Great Indian Bustard is protected in Desert National Park of Rajasthan and Rollapadu Wildlife Sanctuary of Andhra Pradesh.
accepted.tq: Match a species with both of its listed habitats rather than selecting a single familiar site.

accepted.s:
With reference to the Great Indian Bustard, consider the following statements:
1. Its population is less than 150.
2. Rollapadu Wildlife Sanctuary is one of its habitats.
3. A 2024 Supreme Court order concerned underground power lines in relation to its conservation.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: The Great Indian Bustard population is stated to be below 150, Rollapadu is one of its habitats, and the 2024 Supreme Court order addressed underground power lines for its conservation.
accepted.tq: Test numerical, geographical and legal dimensions of one conservation issue together.

accepted.s: Hangul is principally associated with which protected area?
accepted.x: Hangul, or Kashmir stag, is associated with Dachigam National Park in Jammu and Kashmir.
accepted.tq: Directly test the species-to-habitat association without introducing unrelated habitats.

accepted.s: Barasingha is associated with:
accepted.x: Kanha National Park in Madhya Pradesh is the protected-area habitat listed for Barasingha.
accepted.tq: Use nearby protected-area names as plausible wildlife distractors.

accepted.s: The snow leopard is associated with which of the following?
o: Cold Desert Biosphere Reserve and Kibber
Rollapadu Wildlife Sanctuary and Desert National Park
Dachigam National Park and Binsar Wildlife Sanctuary
Kanha National Park and Sitanadi Wildlife Sanctuary
accepted.x: The listed habitats of the snow leopard are the Cold Desert Biosphere Reserve and Kibber.
accepted.tq: Test a paired habitat association using two precise locations.

accepted.s: The Centrally Sponsored Scheme for Integrated Development of Wildlife Habitats species recovery programme covers how many species, including the snow leopard, Asiatic lion and Great Indian Bustard?
accepted.x: The species recovery programme under CSS-IDWH covers 22 species, including the snow leopard, Asiatic lion and Great Indian Bustard.
accepted.tq: Use the distinctive programme count with ascending numerical options.

accepted.s: Which one of the following pairs is NOT correctly matched?
accepted.x: Mahuadanr Wildlife Sanctuary is in Latehar district of Jharkhand, not Almora in Uttarakhand. The other three pairs are correctly matched.
accepted.tq: Find the wrong district-state combination rather than merely identifying a familiar sanctuary.

accepted.s:
Arrange the following Wildlife Sanctuaries from north to south on the basis of their listed locations:
A. Askot
B. Binsar
C. Mahuadanr
D. Sitanadi
accepted.x: Askot in Pithoragarh lies north of Binsar in Almora; Mahuadanr in Jharkhand lies north of Sitanadi in Chhattisgarh. Thus the order is A, B, C, D.
accepted.tq: Use geographical ordering from the districts rather than memorising the sanctuary names alone.

accepted.s: The Supreme Court case associated with eviction notices issued in Agasthyamalai Biosphere Reserve by Tamil Nadu in 2025 is:
o: John Kennedy v. State of Tamil Nadu
T.N. Ravindran v. State of Kerala
M.C. Mehta v. Union of India
accepted.x: Tamil Nadu issued eviction notices in Agasthyamalai Biosphere Reserve after the Supreme Court order in A. John Kennedy v. State of Tamil Nadu in 2025.
accepted.tq: Test the case-name and conservation-area association directly.

accepted.s:
Which of the following statements regarding Andhra Pradesh's protected-area profile is correct?
1. Andhra Pradesh has one tiger reserve, namely Nagarjunasagar-Srisailam Tiger Reserve.
2. Koundinya and Rayala together constitute one elephant reserve.
3. Seshachalam is Andhra Pradesh's one Biosphere Reserve.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: Andhra Pradesh has one tiger reserve, Nagarjunasagar-Srisailam, one elephant reserve formed by Koundinya and Rayala, and one Biosphere Reserve, Seshachalam.
accepted.tq: Combine the State's protected-area categories and test the complete profile.

accepted.s: According to the Andhra Pradesh protected-area profile, the area covered by protected areas is approximately:
accepted.x: Protected areas cover 8,139.88 square kilometres in Andhra Pradesh. The other figures refer respectively to Seshachalam Biosphere Reserve, the percentage expression, and notified forest area.
accepted.tq: Distinguish total forest area, percentage and protected-area area before choosing the figure.

accepted.s: The notified forest area of Andhra Pradesh is approximately what percentage of the State's geographical area?
accepted.x: The notified forest area of Andhra Pradesh is 37,421.11 square kilometres, constituting 22.96 percent of the State's area.
accepted.tq: Match the percentage with the corresponding area statistic instead of the raw number.

accepted.s: Which of the following is NOT one of the three National Parks of Andhra Pradesh listed in the State profile?
accepted.x: The three listed National Parks of Andhra Pradesh are Sri Venkateswara, Papikonda and Rajiv Gandhi (Rameswaram). Kasu Brahmananda Reddy National Park is in Hyderabad, Telangana.
accepted.tq: Use the State-boundary trap and identify the protected area belonging to a neighbouring State.

accepted.s: Papikonda National Park was established in 2008 and has an area of approximately:
accepted.x: Papikonda National Park was established in 2008 and covers approximately 1,012.86 square kilometres.
accepted.tq: Link the establishment year with the distinctive area figure.

accepted.s: Which one of the following correctly describes Nagarjunasagar-Srisailam Tiger Reserve in the Andhra Pradesh context?
o: It is the State's only tiger reserve and has the largest core or critical tiger habitat in the State
It is an elephant reserve formed by Koundinya and Rayala
It is the State's only Biosphere Reserve and is located in Telangana alone
It is the State's smallest National Park, established in 2008
accepted.x: Andhra Pradesh has one tiger reserve, Nagarjunasagar-Srisailam Tiger Reserve, identified as the State's largest by core or critical tiger habitat.
accepted.tq: Ask the candidate to distinguish the State's tiger reserve from its other reserve categories.

accepted.s: Which of the following current measures relates specifically to Andhra Pradesh's wildlife management plans from September 2026?
o: Translocation of gaurs and four tigresses to Nagarjunasagar-Srisailam Tiger Reserve
Introduction of barasingha into Papikonda National Park
Eviction of all villages from Seshachalam Biosphere Reserve
Transfer of snow leopards to Rollapadu Wildlife Sanctuary
accepted.x: Andhra Pradesh planned to translocate gaurs and four tigresses to Nagarjunasagar-Srisailam Tiger Reserve from September 2026.
accepted.tq: Identify the exact species, number and destination in a current-affairs conservation statement.
